title: Booking form with Postgres
name: bookings
prompt: A booking page for my one-person bike repair shop. Visitors pick a free 1-hour slot on a weekday between 9:00 and 17:00 in the next two weeks, enter their name, phone and what's wrong with the bike. I see all bookings in a list, can cancel one, and slots that are taken disappear. Store everything in Postgres.

answers: Visitors do not need to sign in to book. Only I see the list of bookings.
No payments, no emails for now.

edits: Let me block out whole days (holidays) so no slots show on them.
Add a confirmation page with a booking reference the customer can use to cancel their own booking.
